Maya (CS): Quick ask 3 can we draft a customer-friendly launch checklist (one-pager) + a tiny ops appendix? Keep it short and non-technical.
Ravi (Eng): Got it. Ill keep the customer copy verbs-only: CHECK, PREFILL, STREAM, GUARD.
Maya (CS): Also add a simple renewal-risk rubric (green/yellow/red) and a one-click micro-survey.
Ravi (Eng): Draft below. Please sanity-check.

Customer Launch Checklist (copy for product teams)
- CHECK: Run health check: `curl https://api.redwood/v1/tenants/T123/health` -> expect `latency_p95 < 400ms`, `error_rate < 0.5%`.
- PREFILL: Upload your top 20 representative prompts or call the /prefetch endpoint. Mark prefill calls with `prefill:true` in telemetry so CS can filter traces.
- STREAM: Toggle streaming for chat-like UIs to improve perceived latency (optional).
- GUARD: Enable per-route quotas and a conservative burst limit for the first 72 hours.

Weekly self-check (1 min)
- GREEN: usage stable or up; satisfaction >= 4; p95 < 400ms.
- YELLOW: usage down 15-40% OR satisfaction 3-4 OR p95 400-700ms.
- RED: usage down >40% OR satisfaction <= 2 OR p95 > 700ms OR 2+ incidents in 7 days.

Feedback micro-survey (embed/link)
- Q1: "Was output useful?" (Yes / No)
- Q2: "Latency rating" (1-5)
- Q3: "Anything broken?" (open)
- POST responses to: `https://hooks.redwood/internal/cs-feedback?tenant=T123`

Ops appendix (integrators / infra)
- Health quick: `curl -s https://api.redwood/v1/tenants/T123/health | jq '{p95:.latency_p95,err:.error_rate}'`
  - If `err > 0.01` for 10m -> trigger fallback and page oncall.
- Fallback example (YAML style): `fallback_model: small-infer-v1; max_tokens: 256; canary_percent: 5; canary_duration: 24h`
- Client batching (py snippet):
```
buf = []
start = None
def enqueue(msg):
  global start
  if not start: start = time()
  buf.append(msg)
  if token_count(buf) > 200 or time() - start > 0.05:
    post_batch(buf)
    buf.clear()
    start = None
```

Troubleshooting quick hits
- Streaming stalls: compare client_timeout vs server_chunk_timeout; increase client timeout as a quick test.
- Warm pool low: verify prefill calls include `prefill:true` and cache TTL > 30m during ramp.
- P95 spikes: check long contexts, eval jobs, or plugin timeouts.

Maya (CS): Looks good. Action items: Ravi -> export PDF + code bundle (EOD). Dana -> add YAML fallback to runbook (24h). Priya -> embed survey in onboarding email (tomorrow).
infra-bot: Runbook staged at https://redwood.internal/cs/runbooks/launch-mini-play (team-cs access).
